question: Prepare a reproducible NV-Segment-CT fixed-channel softmax finetune command for my mutually exclusive two-label CT dataset. The dataset root is /data/two_label_ct, the datalist is /data/two_label_ct/dataset.json, dataset label 1 maps to VISTA3D class 3, dataset label 2 maps to class 13 in that order, and outputs should go under runs/nvseg_softmax. This is a command-shape review only; do not install packages, clone repositories, or start training in this environment.
ground_truth: The agent provides, but does not execute, the pinned upstream source setup and scripts/run_finetune.py with the exact dataset, datalist, ordered label mapping, --softmax, and caller-provided output directory.
expected_behavior: the command uses skills/nv-segment-ct-finetune/scripts/run_finetune.py
the command includes --dataset-dir /data/two_label_ct, --datalist /data/two_label_ct/dataset.json, and --output-dir runs/nvseg_softmax
the command includes --softmax and the ordered --label-mapping [[1,3],[2,13]]
the agent requires the pinned upstream source checkout through NV_SEGMENT_CT_ROOT or NV_SEGMENT_CTMR_ROOT
the agent does not install packages, clone repositories, or start training during this command-shape review
the answer distinguishes model_softmax.pt from the standard model_finetune.pt checkpoint

question: Prepare an NV-Segment-CT finetune command for my CT dataset at /data/lung_ct with datalist /data/lung_ct/dataset.json. Track the run locally in MLflow experiment nvseg-review with run name trial-01, and write outputs under runs/nvseg_mlflow. This is a command-shape review only; do not install packages or start training in this environment.
ground_truth: The agent provides, but does not execute, scripts/run_finetune.py with the exact dataset, datalist, output directory, --mlflow-experiment-name, and --mlflow-run-name. It omits a remote tracking URI so MONAI uses the local output-directory MLflow store.
expected_behavior: the command uses skills/nv-segment-ct-finetune/scripts/run_finetune.py
the command includes --dataset-dir /data/lung_ct, --datalist /data/lung_ct/dataset.json, and --output-dir runs/nvseg_mlflow
the command includes --mlflow-experiment-name nvseg-review and --mlflow-run-name trial-01
the command does not set --mlflow-tracking-uri because local tracking was requested
the answer identifies runs/nvseg_mlflow/mlruns as the local tracking store
the agent does not install packages or start training during this command-shape review
